text:
Sofia: Heads-up — planning a coordinated rebuild of base images next week to include CVE backports + a smaller rootfs. Need to coordinate KMS key rotation, RBAC adjustments, and new attestations. Proposed window: Wed 21:00-23:00 PT. Thoughts?

Ryan: Wed looks okay for runtime. We should do a canary rollout first (10% of pools). Also need to update imagePullPolicy and manifest hashes so we don't surprise any clusters.

Lia: From audit/compliance — we need a guaranteed audit trail for each rebuilt digest: cosign signature id, signer key-id, build SA, and rollout-phase. Plan to emit structured events to our logging endpoint so SOC can correlate.

sec-oncall: Also add a temporary admission rule to reject unsigned images for prod namespaces until we finish sign+attest. Will coordinate the gate window.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: https://infra.internal/maint/3421 — automatic reminders set (24h and 1h before).

Sofia: Quick gating snippet I prototyped, can someone sanity-check?
```bash
# verify cosign signature via KMS
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/rebuild-key $IMAGE

# on success, post audit event
curl -s -X POST https://audit.internal/events \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"image":"'$IMAGE'","sig":"'$SIG'","key":"'$KEY_ID'","phase":"'$PHASE'"}'
```

Ryan: A few notes: cosign with KMS needs GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS in the build/run env for the service account. Ensure the build SA has only the SignPermission on the KMS key (limit scope). Also CI needs to preserve the key-id in artifacts.

Lia: For ingestion, we'll require the audit payload to include these fields: image, digest, cosign-sig, key-id, build-id, builder-sa, phase, region, and team. I'll add an ingestion schema and a dashboard panel for quick triage.

Sofia: RBAC change proposal: create a role 'image-attester' with minimal permissions limited to KMS Sign for the build SA and read-only access to image metadata in registry. @Ryan @Lia can you review the policy JSON by EOD?

Ryan: Will review. Also ask infra: if registry credentials rotate, we'll need a pre-cutover step to update k8s pull secrets across clusters (staggered). Suggest we stage that 1h before the image cutover.

sec-oncall: Revert plan: keep previous signed digests available for 24h post-cutover. Admission controller must allow either new signed digests or the previous signed digests until we mark the cutoff closed. Prepare playbook entries for a rollback runbook.

Lia: I'll own audit correlation and will produce a replayable SOC query + saved view in Datadog. Will add tags: {\"team\":\"platform\",\"op\":\"image-rebuild\",\"phase\":\"canary\"}.

Sofia: Performance note — rebuild changes layer digests; CDN and node caches may miss temporarily. Ops: please add +10% buffer capacity to autoscalers for 4h after cutover.

ops-bot: CI blueprint updated: https://ci.redwood/blueprints/cosign-attest — include `cosign attest` + `cosign verify` steps and upload `cosign.sig` as build artifact.

Sofia: Thanks all. I'll collect review comments and publish a final cutover checklist tomorrow morning. Ping me for pre-cutover run 1h before window. :white_check_mark:
